declarations.rationale: Internet consultancy/trend-tracking/report business paths form the largest coherent domain family, ahead of firm location and political discourse.
Public attorney title, confirmation and swearing-in paths dominate.
Chairman titles and nomination/tenure paths dominate; nomination alone is not treated as established tenure.
Owned-by and subsidiary-of corporate paths dominate.
Base-in and workers-based-in total four geographic rows, ahead of chair/subcommittee leadership three.
Sent-person-to, trip-to and mission-in paths form the largest coherent physical-movement family; explicit anticipated trips remain ambiguous.
Held-in and coming/enticing/luring an event to a city form the dominant event-location family; actual occurrence is not inferred from bids alone.
Forward president-office paths form the largest specific family, alongside inverse spokesman and chair renomination.
Company national adjectives form the largest clear family; government ownership and Internet domain are separate.
Internet-firm and traffic-measurement business paths dominate, distinct from the financial firm physical location.
Neighborhood/home/street and moving-to-place-in-borough constructions form a containment family, ahead of legislative leadership; geographic roles are checked case by case.
House/company-in and venue-reopening/location paths dominate.
Venue-at/address/garden location paths form the largest coherent family, ahead of political leadership and blame.
Take/seize/march and territorial seizure form the largest political-control family. Generic take alone remains insufficient.
Emigration/immigration/moving to a destination dominates; corrupted person names remain case ambiguities.
Unit-of corporate containment paths dominate; acquisition actor direction is checked.
Director-for/of role paths dominate, distinct from generic movement or political leadership.
Flee-from-place forms the strongest repeated action family; political sovereignty/leadership and population presence are distinct.
Loss-to, opponent and vote competition form the dominant contest family, ahead of public attorney title and national business context.
Held crown/title and champion designation form the largest specific family, ahead of internships and other offices.
Explicit leader-of titles dominate; sports-manager titles form a separate minority role.
Explicit co-founder paths dominate.
Explicit director role paths form the largest specific title family, ahead of political leader paths.
